description: Build an unsigned propose tx. kind=sol-transfer needs recipient+lamports; token-transfer needs mint+recipient+amount (base units); instructions takes raw inner instructions ({programId, accounts, data:base64}) whose payer is the vault PDA. The proposer auto-approves if they can vote.

accounts.description: The instruction's account metas, in the order the target program expects.

isSigner.description: Whether this account must sign the inner instruction.

isWritable.description: Whether the inner instruction mutates this account.

pubkey.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

data.description: Base64 of the instruction data bytes.

programId.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

mint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

multisig.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

proposer.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

recipient.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

name: solknife_multisig_propose_build
